superseded_reason: This run's input, outputs/condition_tfr_maps_p1d1p2d2p3/maps.npz, was generated 2026-08-04 from source_dir=D:/workspace/data/tfr_arrays -- a path context/PROJECT_STATE.md lists under 'Superseded paths -- do not restore'. That predates both the TFR path migration and the 2026-08-11 precompute_tfr_arrays_v2.py .npy->.npz rebuild with 1/f-quality channel screening. Per labyrinth doctrine ('re-verify independently rather than inheriting a prior seal's verdict'), this node's prior 'confirmed'/'verified' status was not earned against the current corpus. This record is left in place, not deleted, per Conservation.
notes: Overnight autonomous build (Hamm away). New script context/figures/fig06_v1_pfc_condition_tfr/fig04_glmm_all_areas_timeresolved.py -- written as a NEW FILE (CLAUDE.md 'preserve originals'), imports fig04_v1_pfc_condition_tfr.py's reusable pieces (load_condition_maps, area_cond_sessions, band_ratio, to_db, GLMM_CONDS/COND_CONTEXT/COND_FAMILY, GLMM_MIN_SESSIONS/GLMM_MIN_ANIMALS) rather than duplicating. Merges CONDITION_AREAS (4) and SUPP_AREAS (6) into one loop over figstyle.AREA_ORDER (10 areas), and adds a `window` level to the (area, band) groupby of both models (P2_WINDOW_MS=1031-1562ms split into 150ms bins: w0 1031-1181, w1 1181-1331, w2 1331-1481, w3 1481-1562(short,81ms) -- decision stated in the script docstring, not tuned per result).
Does NOT resurrect the retired context x family interaction design (explicitly checked against fig04_v1_pfc_condition_tfr.py's own 2026-08-04 docstring before building).

TWO NEW DECLARED FAMILIES (separate from the original single-window families of the same name minus '_timeresolved', per this project's multiplicity rule): fig04_glmm_is_omission_timeresolved and fig04_glmm_omission_type_timeresolved, each 10 areas x 5 bands x 4 windows = up to 200 cells (180 actually fit after the existing GLMM_MIN_SESSIONS=6/GLMM_MIN_ANIMALS=2 gate). Both corrected together via figstats.correct() (Holm + BH within each family).

RESULT, Q1 (is it an omission at all, db~C(context)): 119/180 Holm-significant, 132/180 BH-significant -- the original 4-area/1-window result (a strong, broad effect per fig04's own text) REPLICATES and GENERALIZES: the omission-vs-stimulus power difference is not confined to V1/V3a-d/TEO/PFC or to one collapsed window, it is present across most of the 10-area x 5-band x 4-window grid.

RESULT, Q2 (does omission type -- predictable A/B vs unpredictable R -- matter, among omissions only): 0/180 Holm-significant, 0/180 BH-significant. FULLY NULL at every area x band x window cell tested, same qualitative conclusion as whatever the original single-window Q2 result was (not independently re-read in this pass, but this generalization gives it no support anywhere in the grid) -- reported as a real, well-powered null (180 cells, same model family, many converged cleanly), not a power failure: Q1's same design and same data source finds a strong effect in the majority of cells, so the sliding-window/all-area machinery is demonstrably sensitive to a real effect when one is present.

CONVERGENCE CAVEATS, stated not hidden: 42 fit-warning notes for Q1, 40 for Q2 (mostly FEF, PFC, TEO, MST, MT, V4 -- 'random effects covariance is singular' / 'MLE may be on the boundary' / occasional outright non-convergence retried across optimizers) out of 180 cells each -- consistent with the session-nested random-effects structure being harder to identify in smaller-n area/window cells than the original 4-area/1-window design saw. Full note text preserved in outputs/fig04_glmm_all_areas_timeresolved/receipt.json; a cell with a convergence warning is not excluded from the reported count above, so treat any single cell's Holm/BH flag with the same caution the original figure already applies to convergence-flagged cells.

BUG FOUND AND WORKED AROUND, NOT FIXED AT SOURCE: fig04_v1_pfc_condition_tfr.py hardcodes CONDITION_MAPS/MAPS/OUT_DIR to an absolute 'D:/workspace/omission/...' path that does not exist on this machine (repo is at C:\workspace\omission) -- a drive-remap footgun this project's own CLAUDE.md/omission-data skill explicitly warns about. Confirmed by a live FileNotFoundError. Worked around in the new script by monkeypatching _fig04.CONDITION_MAPS to the correct repo-relative path before calling load_condition_maps() -- NOT fixed in the original file (out of this task's stated scope, and edits to a live manuscript figure script warrant deliberate review). Flagged separately as its own follow-up task (spawn_task, title 'Fix hardcoded D:/workspace paths in fig04 script').
issues: 180/200 possible cells fit per model (20 skipped by the existing GLMM_MIN_SESSIONS/GLMM_MIN_ANIMALS gate) -- not independently checked which 20 specifically, or whether they cluster in a particular area/band (worth a follow-up look if this generalization becomes figure-facing).

Convergence-warning cells (42/180, 40/180) not excluded from the Holm/BH-significant counts above -- a stricter read would drop them before reporting, matching how the original fig04 script's own convergence_notes are surfaced but not auto-filtered.
